_note: The Recess shelf (docs/GAMES.md). One row per game, in shelf order. band: k2, 35, 68, 912 or all (the colored edge). live turns the box into a link. pairs: tool or game ids the game page links under Pairs well with (live ones only). Art is site/templates/recess/art-<id>.svg.

games.title: Farlight
games.blurb: Fly a small ship home to Earth, star by star. Scan strange planets, land and walk on living worlds, and build cozy camps on the way.

games.title: Ripple
games.blurb: Stretch glowing strings across dark water and pluck them. Every note ripples out. Add a beat, layer loops and save your song.

games.title: Time Tides
games.blurb: Slide through 12,000 years and watch empires swell, split and fade like tides across an old paper map. Follow a story, chase one empire through time, or just press Play.

games.title: Go
games.blurb: Surround more of the board than your rival. Stones click down; captured groups wash away like ink.

games.title: Chess
games.blurb: A paper theatre lit from the side. Play the computer, a friend, or a quick mate-in-one.

games.title: Checkers
games.blurb: Neon pucks on a glowing grid. Chain your jumps and pop a crown.

games.title: Cargo Hold
games.blurb: Slide the crates to free the hatch. Fewest moves wins the stars.

games.title: Untangle
games.blurb: Drag the stars until no lines cross, and watch the constellation light up.

games.title: Infinite Hike
games.blurb: A trail that never ends, through forest, meadow and mountains. Walk, look around, or switch on auto-walk and just listen.
